title: Glass Stairwell
description: A percussion-led UK garage-house hybrid at 130 BPM where shuffled euclidean hats and clipped claps carry the groove. A chopped, pitched vocal phrase and a plucky detuned stab trade hooks over a sidechained pad, climbing through two euphoric peaks split by a hushed valley.
